name.ja: BB戦士342 許チョガンダム

description.ja: 三璃紗一の怪力！　機駕の剛将“許チョガンダム”がBB戦士に登場。 両肩のパーツは組み合わせて剛鉄球に合体。 5本の烏賊鋼剣は背中や武器に付けるなど、組み合わせ自由。 鎧を取り外せば幼少時代の許チョが再現可能。
description.en: Sanrisaichi’s superhuman strength! The strong commander of the aircraft, “Heo Cho Gundam”, appears in BB Senshi. The parts of both shoulders are combined to form a hard iron ball. You can freely combine the five squid steel swords by attaching them to your back or weapons. By removing the armor, you can recreate Xu Cho from his childhood.
